elements.text: Many individuals have a penchant for different types of pens and really take an effort in buying one. Now personalize your cap from a range of models and color options to choose from. Send us your design or logo to create your custom caps. Popular choices of print are Embroidery and Sublimation giving a distinctive look when worn with uniforms or for fashion. Also grabs attention during events and can be used as giveaways during exhibitions enhancing brand retention. Caps are also good to use at staff events or corporate events. Whenever your staff or customers are wearing your branded head covering, they’ll be advertising your logo to the world.

T-shirts & Shirts are one of the best marketing tools if done correctly. Gives good exposure to your brand message better than any other channel. Print your logo and disperse it among your clients and customers to boost brand visibility. T-shirt printing enables brands to send the right message to the right audience at the right time.

Custom passport holders and wallet organizers are the perfect business gifts for anyone in the travel industry, great for travel agents, tour companies, cruise lines, and airlines. It’s easy for recipients to keep all of their travel documents in order with a multitude of sizes, styles, and materials from which to choose.

If you’re looking for something more elegant, we have a selection of personalized leather passport covers or holders in which all of your credit cards, business cards and passport can easily and neatly fit. Ash & Sims offer personalized passport holders imprinted or debossed with your company logo.

A personalized flash drive, also known as memory stick, is one of the most popular high-tech promotional products on the market today. Promotional USB drives are the perfect gift for your brand marketing. Imprint your company name and logo on a promotional USB drive for a unique and exciting way to keep your company on the minds of your clients and customers. Our designers are experts at getting your brand logo or slogan from its initial conception onto the final branded USB flash drive.
